programme.title: Quirky Science
programme.desc: Canned food began with Napoleon's contest to preserve food, won by Appert's boiled, sealed bottles. The British later developed metal cans, though early ones exploded or caused illness. Can openers came 30 years later. Pasteur's germ theory explained spoilage. Pressure-cooking improved taste, and now, 'raddaperization'—zapping food—is the future. Canning evolved from battlefield necessity to high-tech preservation.

programme.title: Quirky Science

Fleming later discovered antibiotics by accident. But now, 'superbugs' threaten this miracle cure. Refrigeration, once deadly due to toxic gases, evolved thanks to pressure-cooking and may soon use sound waves. From leeches to lab breakthroughs, medicine keeps evolving—what's next?

programme.desc: We travel to the end of the rainbow in Dublin, Ireland. We'll gawk at the Book of Kells, a holy book displayed at Trinity College. We visited the hallowed halls of St. Patrick's Cathedral, and touched famed Irishman, Daniel O'Connell's crypt at Glasnevin Cemetery. Finally, we learn the complicated history of Irish independence at Kilmainham jail.

programme.title: Travel Thru History
programme.desc: Get your sun tan lotion on, because we're headed to the land of perfect weather and sunsets. We'll sample a fish taco, climb the 100's of steps of the California Tower, stand on the flight deck of the USS Midway, as well as, revisit San Diego's founding on the San Salvador at the San Diego Maritime museum.

programme.title: Nature's Force
programme.desc: Weather is universal and it's also Extra Terrestrial. Learn about space weather and how it can impact us on earth. Supercells are unique storms that scientists have learnt to measure into three types. Under the earth's crust, nature is extremely energetic, and we see this through the Volcano which acts as our eye into the forces beneath our feet. Learn about the purple buzzing glow called St Elmo's Fire, how it was named and were to look for it.

programme.title: Big Coast
programme.desc: Trolling cut plug herring from home base on Denny Island, BC!

programme.title: Destination Wild
programme.desc: The host explores the wildlife of the Great Ocean Road.

programme.title: Sarah Shark
programme.desc: Sarah travels to one of the top 10 dive destinations in Australia (Julian Rocks, Byron Bay, NSW) to dive with three species of Wobbegong Sharks within the Cape Byron Marine Park. She also conducts a street poll with members of the public to find out what they think about sharks.

programme.title: Out Of Town Adventures
programme.sub-title: Lake Charles, Louisiana: When You're Not in New Orleans at Mardi Gras Time
programme.desc: It's Carnival time in Louisiana! And that means, food, food, costumes, music and the odd chicken run! See how Mardi Gras in New Orleans has nothin' on little Lake Charles.

programme.title: Out Of Town Adventures
programme.sub-title: Guadalajara - Shake It Up! the Birthplace of Mexico's Mariachi and Tequila

programme.title: Music Voyager
programme.sub-title: The Heart of Morocco - The Middle

programme.title: Teuflische Nachbarn
programme.desc: Eine Freundschaft zwischen Nachbarn kühlt deutlich ab, als einer den anderen des Diebstahls bezichtigt. Die Spannungen eskalieren aufgrund von Überwachungs- und Denunziationsvorwürfen, was zu einem gewalttätigen Vorfall und einer tödlichen Schießerei vor laufender Kamera führt.

programme.title: Teuflische Nachbarn
programme.desc: Zwei Nachbarn, die vom Pech verfolgt sind, finden aufgrund ihrer gemeinsamen Notlage zueinander. Als einer den anderen durch ein schiefgelaufenes Geschäft in Schulden stürzt, bricht alles auseinander. Ihre gegenseitige Abhängigkeit hält sie jedoch bis zu einem Racheakt zusammen.

programme.title: Bloodline Detectives - Die DNA der Täter
programme.desc: Snohomish County, 1972: Eine junge Frau wird blutüberströmt am Straßenrand entdeckt. Sie wird ins Krankenhaus gebracht, wo sie kurze Zeit später an einer Schusswunde verstirbt. Bei dem Opfer handelt es sich um die 20-jährige Jody Loomis, die wenige Stunden zuvor verschwunden war. Es wird über 40 Jahre dauern, bis die Ermittler den Mann ausfindig machen, der diese abscheuliche Tat begangen hat.

programme.title: Unentdeckt - Mörder unter uns
programme.desc: Die frisch verheiratete Lisa Solomon freut sich darauf, ihren ersten Urlaub mit ihrem Mann Matthew zu verbringen, doch Heiligabend verschwindet Lisa. Matthew gibt eine tränenreiche Pressekonferenz, in der er um die Rückkehr seiner Frau fleht. Polizei und Freiwillige begeben sich auf eine sechstägige Suche nach Lisa. Lisas Leiche wird schließlich in Müllsäcke gestopft gefunden. Sie war in der Nacht ihres Verschwindens erdrosselt worden. Die Polizei muss mögliche Straßenräuber und einen Stalker unter die Lupe nehmen, um einen Mörder zu finden, der es auf die junge Braut abgesehen hatte.

programme.title: K9 - Die Hundestaffel mit Jim Belushi
programme.desc: Nachdem ein Verdächtiger mit einer Limousine verunglückt ist, flüchtet er in ein unwegsames Waldgebiet und weigert sich, sich zu ergeben. Kann "Chase" die Pattsituation beenden? Als ein Mann droht, sich selbst etwas anzutun, ziehen die Polizisten "Milo" hinzu, um die Situation unter Kontrolle zu bringen. Unterdessen steht "Nicky" vor einem Wettlauf gegen die Zeit. Ein vermisstes Kleinkind ist in der weiten Natur verloren gegangen, während das Tageslicht schnell schwindet. Und "Duder" wird hinzugezogen, um bei der Suche nach einem Verdächtigen zu helfen, der sich seit Wochen den Ermittlern entzieht.

programme.title: K9 - Die Hundestaffel mit Jim Belushi
programme.desc: Als ein Verdächtiger deutlich macht, dass er vor niemandem Halt macht, liegt es an "Murphy.

programme.title: K9 - Die Hundestaffel mit Jim Belushi
programme.desc: Der Polizeihund "Cisco" rückt zu einem Einbruch an einem Ort aus, den man am allerwenigsten erwarten würde - der Loge des Berufsverbands der Polizei. Unterdessen wird der Polizeihund "Karma" gegen einen aggressiven Verdächtigen eingesetzt, der sich der Festnahme widersetzt. Nachdem sein Hundeführer von einem Fahrzeug angefahren wurde, setzt der Polizeihund "Jakko" die Verfolgung allein fort und nimmt die Fährte eines bewaffneten Verdächtigen auf. Als der Polizeihund "Mickey" den Verdächtigen schließlich zu Boden bringt, zahlt er dafür einen schmerzhaften Preis.

programme.title: K9 - Die Hundestaffel mit Jim Belushi
programme.desc: Ein Vater liefert sich mit der Polizei eine Hochgeschwindigkeitsverfolgungsjagd, während sein Kleinkind im Auto sitzt. Der Polizeihund "Keanu" wird in eine brisante Pattsituation geschickt, in der jede Sekunde zählt. "Kyro" spürt das entscheidende Beweisstück auf: eine Waffe, die ein flüchtender Verdächtiger weggeworfen hat. "Lupo" kämpft sich durch dichtes, unwegsames Gestrüpp, verfängt sich unter niedrigen Ästen, weigert sich jedoch aufzugeben und kämpft sich weiter voran, um den Verdächtigen zu stellen. Unterdessen wird "Taco.

programme.title: Bloodline Detectives - Die DNA der Täter
programme.desc: 1992 wird die verstümmelte Leiche der 22-jährigen Angela Brosso gefunden, die in der Nacht zuvor bei einer Fahrradtour verschwunden war. Zehn Monate später wird auch die Leiche der 17-jährigen Melanie Bernas am Kanal gefunden. Die Taten werden als "Phoenix-Kanal-Morde" bekannt. Engagierte Ermittler und bahnbrechende DNA-Forschung führen zu einem Mann, der als "Zombie-Jäger" bekannt ist, und bringen diesen sadistischen Serienmörder mehr als 20 Jahre nach seinem ersten bekannten Mord hinter Gitter.

programme.title: Bloodline Detectives - Die DNA der Täter
programme.desc: Dezember 1988: Ein angehender Ehemann kommt nach der Arbeit in der Kleinstadt Three Rivers, Michigan, nach Hause und findet seine Verlobte erstochen im Türrahmen ihres Schlafzimmers, während ihre acht Monate alte Tochter unversehrt in ihrer Wiege liegt. Es braucht 34 Jahre, vorausschauende Ermittler und modernste Wissenschaft, um das Rätsel zu lösen, wer einer inzwischen erwachsenen Frau vor all den Jahren ihre liebevolle Mutter geraubt hat.

programme.title: Der letzte Klick - Tödliche Online-Begegnungen
programme.desc: Bashar Jackson war auch als "Pop Smoke" bekannt, ein Superstar-Rapper mit Verbindungen zu 50 Cent. Bashar war auf einer Reise nach Los Angeles und wohnte in einer Villa in der Gegend von Beverly Hills. Nach einem nächtlichen Einbruch in sein Haus, der möglicherweise über eine Immobilien-Website eingefädelt wurde, und einem versehentlichen Beitrag in den sozialen Medien, in dem er seinen Aufenthaltsort bekannt gab, traf Pop Smoke auf seinen Mörder.

programme.title: #TextMeWhenYouGetHome
programme.desc: Die Vermissten- und Mordrate bei indigenen Frauen ist unverhältnismäßig viel höher als bei jeder anderen Bevölkerungsgruppe. Als die schöne Jalajhia Finklea einen Tag vor ihrem 18. Geburtstag verschwand, wurden die Mitglieder ihres Wampanoag-Stammes sofort aktiv. Der Stamm und die Familie von Jalajhia fanden schnell heraus, dass ihr Entführer ihr näher stand, als sie dachten.

programme.title: #TextMeWhenYouGetHome
programme.desc: Als die zweifache Mutter Deanna Cook ihren täglichen Anruf bei ihrer Mutter versäumte, begann sich ihre Familie Sorgen zu machen, dass Deannas "Stalker" etwas damit zu tun haben könnte. Nachdem sie Deanna eine SMS geschickt und angerufen hatte, rief ihre Familie den Notruf an. Doch als ihr Anruf auf taube Ohren stieß, musste die Familie eine schockierende Entdeckung machen.

programme.title: Frauen im Todestrakt
programme.desc: Linda Carty wurde am 19. Februar 2001 für die Entführung des drei Tage alten Neugeborenen Ray Cabrera sowie für die Entführung und Ermordung seiner Mutter Joana Rodriguez zum Tode verurteilt. Obwohl sie zum Zeitpunkt des Verbrechens in Texas lebte, ist Cartys Fall umstritten, da sie aus St. Kitts stammt und die britische Staatsbürgerschaft besitzt. Diejenigen, die an dem Fall gearbeitet haben, und Experten für den Todestrakt und das Strafrechtssystem reflektieren über den Fall und darüber, wie es zu Cartys Todesurteil kam.

programme.title: Frauen im Todestrakt
programme.desc: Am 23. Mai 1995 wurde Kerry Lyn Dalton für die Folterung und Ermordung von Irene "Melanie" May zum Tode verurteilt. Melanie wurde zuletzt am 26. Juni 1988 lebend gesehen. Da sie drogenabhängig war und keinen festen Wohnsitz hatte, unternahm die Polizei wenig, um ihr Verschwinden zu untersuchen. Erst vier Jahre später nahm die Polizei Kerry und zwei andere fest, nachdem mehrere Zeugen den Behörden berichtet hatten, dass die drei offen damit geprahlt hätten, Melanie geschlagen, erstochen und mit Batteriesäure übergossen zu haben, bevor sie ihre Leiche zerstückelten und in der Wüste vergruben.

programme.title: Unentdeckt - Mörder unter uns
programme.desc: Die frisch verheiratete Lisa Solomon freut sich darauf, ihren ersten Urlaub mit ihrem Mann Matthew zu verbringen, doch Heiligabend verschwindet Lisa. Matthew gibt eine tränenreiche Pressekonferenz, in der er um die Rückkehr seiner Frau fleht. Polizei und Freiwillige begeben sich auf eine sechstägige Suche nach Lisa. Lisas Leiche wird schließlich in Müllsäcke gestopft gefunden. Sie war in der Nacht ihres Verschwindens erdrosselt worden. Die Polizei muss mögliche Straßenräuber und einen Stalker unter die Lupe nehmen, um einen Mörder zu finden, der es auf die junge Braut abgesehen hatte.

programme.title: Cops Gone Bad - Verbrecher in Uniform
programme.desc: David Carricks Serie von Vergewaltigungen, Folterungen und Erniedrigungen von Frauen erstreckte sich über fast 20 Jahre, während er bei der Londoner Metropolitan Police tätig war. Carrick benutzte seinen Dienstausweis, um Frauen davon zu überzeugen, dass er vertrauenswürdig sei, um sie dann in sein Haus oder in ein Hotelzimmer zu locken und dort die schrecklichsten Akte sexueller Gewalt zu begehen. Carricks Schreckensherrschaft begann zu bröckeln, als eine Frau im Jahr 2021 schließlich die Polizei anrief, um anzuzeigen, dass Carrick sie vergewaltigt hatte. Bald folgten viele andere.

programme.title: Cops Gone Bad - Verbrecher in Uniform
programme.desc: Auf einer Landstraße im Großraum Manchester werden Rettungskräfte in der Nacht zu einem verheerenden Autounfall gerufen. Eine junge Frau sitzt auf dem Fahrersitz und hat schreckliche Kopfverletzungen, doch ihr Verlobter, der Polizist Martin Alex Forshaw, ist kaum verletzt. Forshaw berichtet den Rettungskräften, dass seine Verlobte Claire Howarth von der Straße abkam, als sie nach einer CD suchte, aber einige Dinge am Unfallort passen nicht zusammen. Eine Geschichte von Verrat, Feigheit und Lügen entfaltet sich, als die ganze Wahrheit darüber ans Licht kommt, was Claire Howarth zugestoßen ist.

programme.title: Hours to Kill - Zeitachse des Todes
programme.desc: In einem noblen Vorort von Manhattan foltern und verprügeln Killer den Millionär Ben Novak jr. in seinem Hotelzimmer. Als die Ermittler seine Hände, Beine und seinen Mund mit Klebeband gefesselt, seine Kehle aufgeschlitzt und seine Augen ausgestochen vorfinden, stellen sie fest, dass sie nach zwei oder mehr Tätern suchen. In einem Hotel, das mit Tausenden von Kongressteilnehmern gefüllt ist, stoßen die Ermittler bald auf eine lange Liste von Feinden. Jeder hat ein Motiv, und alle zeigen mit dem Finger auf jemand anderen.

programme.title: Hours to Kill - Zeitachse des Todes
programme.desc: Ein Bewaffneter tötet Laura Grillo, eine 37-jährige freiwillige Polizeibeamtin und Mutter von drei Kindern, in der Küche ihres Hauses in einem Vorort von Dallas. Zunächst vermuten die Ermittler einen Einbrecher. Aber in einem hochkarätigen Fall, in den mehrere Behörden involviert sind und der die Staatsgrenzen überschreitet, müssen die Ermittler eine bahnbrechende Anschuldigung mit einer alles verändernden E-Mail und einem teuflischen Drahtzieher in Verbindung bringen, der glaubt, er könne das Gesetz überlisten.

programme.title: Bloodline Detectives - Die DNA der Täter
programme.desc: Willoughby, Ohio, 1980: Mark Madger kommt nach Hause und findet seine Frau Nadine in einer Blutlache mit einem Küchenmesser in der Brust auf. Ihr kleiner Sohn wird unverletzt in seinem Laufstall neben der Leiche gefunden. Die Ermittler haben Mühe, ein Motiv für diesen barbarischen Mord zu finden, und der Verdacht fällt auf ihren Ehemann. Erst Jahrzehnte später liefert modernste DNA-Wissenschaft die Antworten, auf die die Familie Madger ein Leben lang gewartet hat.

programme.title: City Confidential - Verbrechen nebenan
programme.desc: Die Militärgemeinde in Fort Meade ist schockiert, als eine Soldatin in ihrem Stadthaus erschossen wird. Fast ein Jahr lang arbeiten Ermittler mehrerer Strafverfolgungsbehörden unermüdlich daran, eine verworrene Geschichte voller Geheimnisse und Lügen aufzudecken, die zu diesem Mord geführt hat.

programme.title: City Confidential - Verbrechen nebenan
programme.desc: Die Weihnachtsstimmung in Marietta, Georgia, nimmt ein jähes Ende, als einer der Einwohner der Stadt in seinem eigenen Haus ermordet aufgefunden wird. Um das Rätsel zu lösen, stützt sich die Polizei auf die Hilfe der Einwohner, die dabei helfen, eine heimtückische Verschwörung aufzudecken.

programme.title: Meet, Marry, Murder - Tödliche Ehe
programme.desc: 1998 starb Julie unter mysteriösen Umständen, hinterließ jedoch eine warnende Botschaft. In einem Brief, den sie vor ihrem Tod verfasst hatte, wies sie darauf hin, dass ihr Ehemann fähig sei, sie zu töten.

programme.title: Meet, Marry, Murder - Tödliche Ehe
programme.desc: Becky, eine beliebte Mutter von drei Kindern aus Illinois, wurde im Jahr 2023 erschossen in ihrem Haus aufgefunden. Schnell richtete sich der Verdacht gegen den Mann, dem sie einst am meisten vertraut hatte: ihren getrenntlebenden Ehemann Tim.

programme.title: Teuflische Nachbarn
programme.desc: Ein freundliches Rentnerehepaar bezaubert eine Familie mit kleinen Kindern, als diese nebenan einzieht. Doch dann greift der Hund des neuen Nachbarn die Mutter der Kinder an und löst einen heftigen Konflikt aus, der in zwei schockierenden Morden endet.

programme.title: Witness to Murder - Digitale Zeugen
programme.desc: Eine Dreiecksbeziehung an der Universität von Florida endet mit dem Mord an einem beliebten Studenten. Eine eindeutige digitale Spur führt direkt zu seinem Mörder und hilft den Behörden, die Details des Verbrechens zusammenzusetzen und eine Verurteilung zu erreichen.

programme.title: Witness to Murder - Digitale Zeugen
programme.desc: Nach dem grausamen Mord an einem angehenden Schauspieler in Georgia gehen der Polizei schnell die Spuren aus. Doch ein neues digitales forensisches Werkzeug bringt neuen Schwung in die Ermittlungen und ermöglicht es den Behörden, den Mörder präzise zu identifizieren.

programme.title: Richard Spencer - Gefangen in meiner Ehe
programme.desc: Sheree Spencer war eine gewalttätige Frau, die ihren Mann Richard zwanzig Jahre lang in Angst leben ließ. Anhand von bisher unveröffentlichtem, heimlich aufgenommenem Filmmaterial und Aufnahmen von Polizeikameras erzählt die Dokumentation die schockierende Geschichte einer langen Reihe von Misshandlungen und der Verhaftung von Sheree Spencer. Nachdem Richard endlich den Mut gefunden hatte, darüber zu sprechen, leitete die Polizei von Humberside eine akribische Untersuchung der zwei Jahrzehnte andauernden Misshandlungen ein.

programme.title: Richard Spencer - Gefangen in meiner Ehe
programme.desc: Die Polizei von Humberside versuchte, sich ein Bild vom Ausmaß des Missbrauchs zu machen, den Richard durch seine Frau erlitten hatte. Bislang unveröffentlichte Vernehmungsprotokolle, heimlich aufgenommene Videos des Missbrauchs und Aussagen des Ermittlungsteams zeichnen den Verlauf der Ermittlungen nach. Sheree Spencer wurde schließlich zu vier Jahren Haft verurteilt. Die Episode zeigt auch, wie Richard diese scheinbar unerträgliche Tortur überstanden und begonnen hat, sein Leben neu aufzubauen.

programme.title: K9 - Die Hundestaffel mit Jim Belushi
programme.desc: "Duke" stellt seine herausragende Beweglichkeit bei einem risikoreichen Festnahmeeinsatz unter Beweis, der eine langwierige Pattsituation innerhalb von Sekunden beendet. Die Polizei von Las Vegas setzt alle Hebel in Bewegung, um einen der ihren zu retten, nachdem ein verzweifelter Verdächtiger gewalttätig wird und "Enzo" angreift. "Carrier" beweist einmal mehr: Wenn seine Spürnase im Einsatz ist, gibt es kein Entkommen und kein Versteck mehr. Und selbst nachdem sein Hundeführer schwer gestürzt ist, bleibt "Jedi" unerbittlich am Ball und verfolgt und fasst einen flüchtenden Verdächtigen.

programme.title: K9 - Die Hundestaffel mit Jim Belushi
programme.desc: "Shep" und sein Hundeführer sorgten für Aufsehen, nachdem sich ihre Bodycam-Aufnahmen im Internet verbreitet hatten. "Robby" gibt dem Neuling "Seff" die Chance, sich zu beweisen und den Verdächtigen zu fassen. Unterdessen befinden sich "Jax" und sein Hundeführer in einer Pattsituation mit einem Verdächtigen, der sich auf einem Baum verschanzt hat und die Beamten dazu zwingt, stundenlang abzuwarten. "Mercury" beweist, dass er mehr ist als nur ein reiner Drogenspürhund, als er eingesetzt wird, um eine ältere Frau aufzuspüren, die zu einem Spaziergang aufgebrochen war und nie zurückgekehrt ist.

programme.title: K9 - Die Hundestaffel mit Jim Belushi
programme.desc: "Lord" und sein Hundeführer sind preisgekrönte Fährtenleser - doch bei diesem Einsatz kommt es nicht nur auf ihr Können an, sondern vor allem auf Teamarbeit, als sie die Verfolgung über einen Zaun fortsetzen und sich einem Verdächtigen nähern. Unterdessen jagt "Bingo" einen mutmaßlich bewaffneten Verdächtigen, der in einen belebten Park geflohen ist. Mitten in der Nacht sucht "Odin" nach dem Fahrer eines als gestohlen gemeldeten Fahrzeugs, und "Holmes" und "Baro" arbeiten im Team, um zwei Verdächtige aufzuspüren und zu stellen, die sich tief im Wald versteckt halten.

programme.title: K9 - Die Hundestaffel mit Jim Belushi
programme.desc: In Texas ist alles größer - außer den Verstecken -, und "Enzo" beweist es, indem er einen Verdächtigen aufspürt, der sich unter einem Haus verkrochen hat. In der Nachtschicht tritt der Neuling "Deebo" in den Vordergrund und zeigt, dass er es wirklich draufhat. In Florida sperren Polizeibeamte den Verkehr für eine Hubschrauberlandung und bringen "Huk" eilig in ein Notfallkrankenhaus. An anderer Stelle stürzt sich "Diesel" kopfüber in dunkles Wasser, um einen Verdächtigen zu verfolgen, und "Vinnie" wird eingesetzt, um einen gefährlichen Verdächtigen zu überwältigen, der Molotowcocktails wirft.

programme.title: City Confidential - Verbrechen nebenan
programme.desc: Die Militärgemeinde in Fort Meade ist schockiert, als eine Soldatin in ihrem Stadthaus erschossen wird. Fast ein Jahr lang arbeiten Ermittler mehrerer Strafverfolgungsbehörden unermüdlich daran, eine verworrene Geschichte voller Geheimnisse und Lügen aufzudecken, die zu diesem Mord geführt hat.

programme.title: City Confidential - Verbrechen nebenan
programme.desc: Die Weihnachtsstimmung in Marietta, Georgia, nimmt ein jähes Ende, als einer der Einwohner der Stadt in seinem eigenen Haus ermordet aufgefunden wird. Um das Rätsel zu lösen, stützt sich die Polizei auf die Hilfe der Einwohner, die dabei helfen, eine heimtückische Verschwörung aufzudecken.

programme.title: The First 48
programme.desc: Nachdem eine 69-jährige Frau tot in ihrer Badewanne aufgefunden wurde, verwickelt ein Verdächtiger die Ermittler in Tulsa in eine rasante Verfolgungsjagd, die tragisch endet.

programme.title: Witness to Murder - Digitale Zeugen
programme.desc: Als in Nordkalifornien zwei Klassenkameraden im Teenageralter im Abstand von einigen Wochen verschwinden, haben ihre Mütter Mühe, die Polizei dazu zu bringen, den Fall ernst zu nehmen. Doch dann kommen ungewöhnliche Handy-Aktivitäten einer Gruppe potenzieller Verdächtiger ans Tageslicht, die den Fall auf den Kopf stellen.

programme.title: Witness to Murder - Digitale Zeugen
programme.desc: Nachdem eine junge Frau in South Carolina tot in ihrer Badewanne aufgefunden wurde, konzentrieren sich die Ermittlungen auf ihren getrenntlebenden Ehemann und ihren Freund. Ein unerwarteter digitaler Anhaltspunkt führt dazu, dass eine dieser Personen versehentlich den Mord gesteht.

programme.title: Ruby Franke - Abgründe einer Influencerin
programme.desc: Hinter Ruby Frankes Aufstieg zur "Momfluencerin" mit Millionen von Followern verbarg sich ein Albtraum. Als ihr Sohn floh und einen Nachbarn auf den Missbrauch aufmerksam machte, führte die Polizei eine Razzia in ihrer Wohnung durch und rettete ihre Kinder.

programme.title: Der Kannibale von Rotenburg - Mord mit Einwilligung?
programme.desc: Armin Meiwes hatte sein ganzes Leben lang davon geträumt hatte, einen anderen Mann zu essen. Im Internet fand er ein williges Opfer - jemanden, der sich bereit erklärt, sich zum sexuellen Vergnügen zerstückeln und verspeisen zu lassen. Die Dokumentation erzählt die schockierende Geschichte hinter einem der berüchtigtsten Kannibalen der Welt, kommentiert von denjenigen, die mit dem Fall am engsten vertraut sind. Sie decken auf, wie die Leben des Mörders und des Opfers zu ihrer verhängnisvollen gemeinsamen Nacht führten.

programme.title: Die Psyche eines Mörders
programme.desc: Im Jahr 2021 erstach der 19-jährige Brian Cohee jr. den 69-jährigen Obdachlosen Warren Barnes in Grand Junction, Colorado. Brian schnitt Warren den Kopf und die Hände ab und versteckte sie in seiner Wohnung. Als Brians Eltern sie fanden, riefen sie den Polizei-Notruf an.

programme.title: Die Psyche eines Mörders
programme.desc: In Clearwater, Florida, ermordete Rebecca Fenton ihren Ehemann und täuschte einen Einbruch vor. Hinter ihrem ruhigen, auf ihr Image bedachten Auftreten verbarg sich eine erschreckende Psyche. Sie wurde 2015 zu lebenslanger Haft verurteilt.

programme.title: The First 48
programme.desc: Nachdem eine 69-jährige Frau tot in ihrer Badewanne aufgefunden wurde, verwickelt ein Verdächtiger die Ermittler in Tulsa in eine rasante Verfolgungsjagd, die tragisch endet.

programme.title: Meet, Marry, Murder - Tödliche Ehe
programme.desc: Als Jamie erschossen wird, erzählt seine Frau der Polizei, dass ein maskierter Fremder sie während ihres morgendlichen Spaziergangs angegriffen habe. Die forensischen Beweise und die Telefonaufzeichnungen erzählen jedoch eine andere Geschichte.

programme.title: Meet, Marry, Murder - Tödliche Ehe
programme.desc: Als Nicole Montalvo verschwand, nachdem sie ihren Sohn im Haus der Familie ihres getrenntlebenden Mannes in St. Cloud, Florida, abgesetzt hatte, fiel der Verdacht auf diese. Nicole hatte eine von Missbrauch geprägte Ehe hinter sich gelassen und war dabei, sich ein neues Leben aufzubauen - doch sie konnte sich der Kontrolle der Familie nicht entziehen.

programme.title: Teuflische Nachbarn
programme.desc: Einst befreundete Nachbarn an einer Bergstraße werden zu erbitterten Feinden, nachdem eine Familie wegen eines Diebstahls die Polizei gerufen und damit gegen die unausgesprochene Tradition verstoßen hat, die Behörden aus Streitigkeiten herauszuhalten. Der jahrelange Konflikt gipfelt schließlich in Schüssen.

programme.title: Vet Tales S1 - "Boss"

programme.title: Vet Tales S1 - "Darting"
programme.desc: Stacey discovers Marama the poodle has breast cancer, Mark tries to save a herd of pregnant cows from miscarrying and the Vet North team dart calves amongst the dinosaurs.

programme.title: Vet Tales S1 - "Molly"
programme.desc: Molly the dog is paralysed in a hit and run accident, Mark is having a busy day with pigs, goats, horses and a mauled cow and Stacey treats a tortoise with a sore leg.

programme.title: Vet Tales S1 - "Bear"
programme.desc: Bear the Labrador has come into see Stacey again for a sore knee. Stacey travels up to Auckland to assist Mark with a calf that’s stuck in the birth cannel.

programme.title: Vet Tales S1 - "Cuban"
programme.desc: Bear the labrador has a sore leg, which turns into a really expensive problem and Mark travels down to Rotorua to help Stacey with a busy day on the farm.

programme.title: Vet Tales S1 - "Sushi"
programme.desc: Mark tries to save a girl’s pet lamb, Stacey treats Max who has bad arthritis and both Mark and Stacey volunteer for the day at SPCA.

programme.title: Vet Tales S1 - "Robbie"
programme.desc: Howdie and Dawn are working dogs and their owner wants them to mate, but neither are interested so Stacey intervenes, Mark treats a horse with a very sore leg and Stacey operates on sushi the cat who has skin cancer.

programme.title: Vet Tales S1 - "Willow"
programme.desc: Willow’s leg is lame and Stacey decides to amputate, Jack the Jack Russel has been kicked out of doggy school and Stacey tries to help and Mark changes Shadow the cat from a male into a female.

programme.title: Super Senses S1 - "Sight"
programme.desc: In this episode we'll explore the animal sense of sight, and you’ll see there’s a lot more to this than meets the naked eye. People with good vision are sometimes called "eagle eyed", but eagles can see a fish from many dozen metres away.

programme.title: Super Senses S1 - "Hearing"
programme.desc: On this episode we travel from the desert, to the forest, Australia to Borneo and back to learn how species as diverse as Bat-eared Foxes, the Bilby, Deer, Kangaroo Rats, cicadas, Proboscis Monkeys and other creatures never miss an auditory trick.

programme.title: Super Senses S1 - "Touch"
programme.desc: On this episode of Animal Super Senses, we get in touch with the feelings of wild animals. Really in touch. Because animals, just like humans, rely heavily on their sense of touch, every day in every way.

programme.title: Super Senses S1 - "Taste and Smell"
programme.desc: On this episode of Animal Super Senses, we examine how things taste, and how vital scent is from the animal perspective. But their sense of smell will also detect the scent of odorants carried through the air.

programme.title: Super Senses S1 - "Superhuman Senses"
programme.desc: There are senses we share with most animals, but what about those senses that human is equipped with? Infrared light, electromagnetic waves and ultrasound, are all found within a spectrum of sensory information that just passes by ordinary humans.

programme.title: Super Senses S1 - "Sixth Sense"
programme.desc: There’s a whole world and more than one spectrum of sensations that animals are aware of, yet which just pass humans by. There’s a kind of “sixth sense” that some animals have which still defies explanation.

programme.title: Super Senses S1 - "Sense of Timing"
programme.desc: In this episode, we examine how every animal has what could be called a sense of rhythm – the human animal included. To give an obvious example, there’s our internal body clock which responds to the so-called Circadian rhythm.

programme.title: Super Senses S1 - "Underwater"
programme.desc: While all life began in the oceans, human beings now rely on technology to navigate the seven seas – left to our own devices; we’re like the proverbial fish out of water. Only the other way around.

programme.title: Super Senses S1 - "Sky"
programme.desc: Animals that live life on the wing, have a vast expanse of sky to navigate, find mates, locate food, and avoid predators in… Living in this aerial realm requires a unique set of senses, specialized to cope with life above ground…

programme.title: Super Senses S1 - "Night"
programme.desc: We find out about the animals that live in the shadows and the adaptations they need to survive. Nocturnal animals have taken to this dark world for good reason. You need some special abilities to cope with the lack of light.

programme.title: Super Senses S1 - "Earth"
programme.desc: We find out more about the animals that have their feet firmly planted on or under the ground. And find out how their senses are tuned to survive. What we see above the ground is only a small part of the natural world.

programme.title: Super Senses S1 - "Communication"
programme.desc: Animals use communication to attract mates,warn off predators, defend territory, or trick their prey. And of course, it’s the senses that play the key role - Sight, smell, taste, touch, and hearing - all are employed to send signals to others.

programme.title: Super Senses S1 - "The Most Amazing Senses"
programme.desc: In this last episode of Super Senses we take the grand final tour to see the greatest of all the special weapons that help some animals to govern the wilderness. In this episode we see it, hear it, touch it, smell it and taste it like animals do.

programme.title: Local Knowledge
programme.desc: Water quality is everything—and the Star brite - SeaSafe team is back at it for the second year in a row! Led by Cory Redwine, Conservation Director of Project SeaSafe, this is the 4th Annual Clean Water Collective and it’s bigger than ever. This time, we’re in Grant, Florida, where 4 million clams are being released into the Indian River Lagoon, paired with the planting of thousands of mangroves, oyster work by CCA and trash clean ups to help restore one of Florida’s most critical ecosystems. But it’s not just about hard work—it’s about connection. With local captains, fishing legends, and the Local Knowledge crew on hand, we hit the water to show why this place is worth fighting for. From clam drops by drone, to in-water mangrove planting, to monster snook catches, this is hands-on conservation at its best. This two-part series kicks off with action, heart, and the kind of hope only a healthy waterway can bring. Don’t miss Part 1—where conservation meets community and everyone gets their hands wet.

programme.title: Local Knowledge

The bite wasn't easy, but that didn't stop Rush from smashing his personal best - not once, but twice - in one unforgettable day on the water. programme.title: mareTV: Corsica - Fascinating Mountain World in the Mediterranean
programme.desc: Corsica looks like an alpine landscape in the Mediterranean, an island with dramatic rock formations, romantic bays and proud inhabitants who see themselves first and foremost as Corsicans and only then as French. The Greeks in ancient times called the island Kalliste: the beautiful. We explore this fascinating mountain world in the Mediterranean.

programme.title: Baltic National Parks
programme.desc: Soomaa National Park is one of Europes wettest wilderness areas. Floods, forests and wetlands create a landscape where canoes replace roads during the fifth season.

programme.title: Baltic National Parks
programme.desc: Gauja National Park in Latvia features diverse wildlife, red sandstone cliffs and a winding river that flows through forests shaped by long human history.

programme.title: The Secret world of Herbs
programme.desc: Secluded for many centuries in inaccessible valleys, the inhabitants of the Alps had no alternative but to rely on the healing powers of nature. A knowledge of herbs was deeply rooted in these mountain-dwellers’ everyday lives – until the twentieth century, when this wisdom became eclipsed by modern academic medicine. Today, Alpine herbs are witnessing a revival, as public interest in regional natural treasures grows. The potential of Alpine herbs is far from exhausted. In the Berchtesgaden Alps, the film shows Hubsi Ilsanker at work as a root-digger, a back-breaking job that has scarcely changed in four hundred years. Authorized by a special historic permit to supply the oldest gentian distillery in Germany, Hubsi digs for protected gentian roots in Berchtesgaden National Park. For yellow gentian is one of the most bitter medicinal herbs in the world, well suited for schnapps and as a general tonic.

programme.title: The Secret world of Herbs
programme.desc: In the pristine nature and mild climate of southeastern Europe grows a unique diversity of wild plants. Far removed from major industry and polluted soils, the Balkan countries have become the largest exporter of herbs in Europe. In Bulgaria alone, more than 300,000 people work with domestic plants. The business is becoming increasingly lucrative. The film takes us to the Croatian coast. On the Adriatic island of Cres, the audience meets Mladen Dragoslavić. In May, when the sage begins to blossom, this beekeeper has one month to produce his income for an entire year – always with the goal of creating the best sage honey in the Balkans. Given a choice, the bees would never choose sage, for entering and exiting the narrow blossom is strenuous. Within three weeks, maximum, Mladen must remove his bees from the island. Otherwise they will die of exhaustion. In Skopje, the capital of Macedonia, the film visits Iva Yosifova. Hollyhock provides the raw material for her objects of art. The herb is medically beneficial, due to its mucilage, which is added to many cough tea mixtures. Iva, though, makes paper from hollyhock. Thanks to the herb’s long fibres, the paper can be spread onto objects and modeled. The technique produces delicate sculptures, as fragile as nature.

programme.title: Stories of the Mediterranean Forest: Sierra Morena
programme.desc: The Mediterranean Basin is one of the planet’s most biologically rich and complex regions. The crossroads of Europe, Asia and Africa is considered to be one of Earth’s biodiversity hotspots. A vast number of both animal and plant species unique to the region live in its various habitats. The Mediterranean Basin is located in one of the planet’s temperate zones. The subtropical climate makes it colder and wet here in winter, hot and dry in summer and mild and rainy in autumn and spring.

programme.title: Fertile Floods - Croatia's Wetlands
programme.desc: Every year, in the middle of Croatia, it's the same story: after the annual snowmelt, a huge flood wave spills out of the Alps toward Zagreb and Belgrade. This leads to an increase in the River Sava's water levels of some ten metres. The contents of more than ten billion bathtubs floods an area the size of Lake Constance, often for months on end, yet still the Croatian and Serbian capital is spared a flood disaster. One of the reasons for this is the fact that the Sava is able to flow unhindered. The annual floods not only create a natural retention reservoir for flood control: alongside the Sava lies a natural paradise, unique in Central Europe. In the species-rich, alluvial flood forests of the last major meadow landscapes of the continent, enormous predatory fish like the catfish lie in wait for prey. The fertile floodplains of the Sava are an important resting place for more than 240 bird species, including Hoopoe, great crested Grebe, little Egret, common snipe and pied Avocet. Old, domestic livestock breeds like the Turopolje pig and Posavina horse spend almost the entire year in the floodplains. They appreciate the alluvial meadows, keep puddles and mudholes open whilst wallowing and, as living lawnmowers, they ensure that the moist meadows aren't transformed into dense oak forests. Thanks to this traditional pasture farming, more than 700 pairs of white stork alone breed in the Lonjsko Polje National Park. The Sava Floodplains allow us to glance into the past of our continent and at the same time, illustrate just how flood protection for major towns can be perfected.

programme.title: Europe's Wild River - The Elbe - 1.000 Miles of Wildlife and Nature
programme.desc: The river rises in the Czech Giant Mountains. Here it is called the Labe. After Děčín it flows into Germany and is called Elbe. There are various explanations for the origin of the river name "Elbe". One often mentioned is the Latin name of the river "albia", which means "bright water". This would also explain why the stream is referred to with the feminine article "the Elbe", since the Latin term "albia" is also feminine. Rather poetic than linguistically probable, however, is the explanation that elves (Middle High German: alb) scurrying around the pines in the white river mists could have helped the river to get its name. Geographically, the river can be divided into different sections: The Upper Elbe is the part from the source to about Riesa in the administrative district of Dresden, which is more characterized by mountains. The Middle Elbe, on the other hand, is a lowland river. It reaches as far as the Geesthacht dam just outside Hamburg. The Lower Elbe is called the tidal part of the river. Here, the Elbe forms an estuary, a so-called estuary. At high tide, seawater enters this funnel-shaped delta at the mouth of the Elbe and mixes with the freshwater of the river. At low tide, the water then flows off to the North Sea. Finally, the continuation of the estuary funnel in the Wadden Sea is called the Outer Elbe.

programme.title: Masai Mara: The Big Hunt
programme.desc: When food supply in the Serengeti dwindles, the Masai Mara is a paradise for predators. As the black wildebeests, gazelles, zebras and antelopes make their yearly trip from the south of the Serengeti to the north, nature’s best laid trap, the Mara River in Kenya is waiting ahead. Captivating shots filmed under water show how crocodiles prepare for the Big Hunt while other predators lurk on the banks awaiting their bounty. The biggest problems for the migratory animals are the Mara and the Tarek River, where they have to put their lives at risk to get to the other side. A great number of them die as they jump into the river and break their legs, while others are carried away by the drift or drown. Those who are not victims of the river itself risk falling prey to the crocodiles. We entered this unchartered territory, the crocodile domain by heading under water. Follow these predators in and around their habitat and watch prides of lions map out their game plan. In slow-motion, we show you the final showdown between predator and prey. Will it be a successful hunt or will the hoofed animals persevere?

programme.title: Magical Moors
programme.desc: Wide open heaths, windswept and barren in winter, are transformed into wonderful carpets of white, fluffy cotton grass in summer. Large bears and wolves roam alongside delicately fluttering butterflies, the bubbling calls of black grouse and the enchanting trills of the great snipe. Moors, bogs and wetlands can be found all over in Europe. Everyone has at least heard about this habitat but most know little about it. It is an ancient yet largely unknown set of landscapes that is full of enchanting surprises. On a warm spring day, poisonous adders emerge from hiding to perform their impressive mating dance. As dusk falls, snipe gather on traditional leks, leaping and singing to impress the opposite sex. And deep down in the boggy marshes, glittering emeralds of sticky dew lure insects into the deadly arms of meat-eating plants. Magical Moors captures the quiet beauty of a spectacular landscape, and its often elusive wildlife, in stunning detail.

programme.title: Aurora - Fire in the Sky
programme.desc: In the earth’s polar regions, a ghostly flicker and colourful glow often brighten the night sky. Whoever sees an aurora event will never forget this impressive experience. Finland’s Saami people, Alaska’s Inuit, Canada’s Native Americans and New Zealand’s Maori all have legends about the origins and meaning of this magic natural spectacle. These stories tell of spirits dancing in the sky, of a bright and better world where hunting game is abundant, of battling gods and celestial messages.

programme.title: 15th Meridian East - Similarity in Difference
programme.desc: The journey leads from the Norwegian Vesterålen to Chad, the Aeolian Islands and the Polish Giant Mountains. As different as the landscapes and cultures may be, all people are united in their love for their children and their desire to give something to tomorrow's generation.

programme.title: 15th Meridian East - Similarity in Difference
programme.desc: What ideas are people on the 15th meridian east developing to shape the future and leave tomorrow's generations a home worth living in? This consequence leads us to four future designers. From the barren Namib Desert to the glacier worlds of Spitsbergen, Sicily and the Croatian Mediterranean.

programme.title: Gronland - In the Glare of Ice
programme.desc: Greenland is the largest island in the world and the landmass closest to the North Pole. 80% of the country is covered by a layer of ice up to 3000 meters thick. Most of the inhabitants of the country are spread over the breathtaking landscape of the ice-free west coast. The country is mostly inhabited by Inuit, who have been feeding on what nature has provided them for thousands of years. But the original life is in a state of change. The modernisation of society and man-made global warming threaten the Arctic natural paradise that is so incredibly important for our planet. Through the eyes of locals we get to know the authentic Greenland.

programme.title: Dust And Stripes
programme.desc: In a never-ending quest for grass and water, the striped herds undertake an annual epic trek across the vast lunar landscape of the Kalahari’s Makgadikgadi Pans. Most of the year, the Makgadikgadi is an inhospitable wasteland of windswept, salt-encrusted pans. For the area’s water-dependent zebra, the Boteti River on the western edge of the pans is a dry-season lifeline. However, it is also a death trap, with lions waiting in ambush and crocodiles lurking in dark riverside caves.

programme.title: Alpine Lakes - Dark Depths and Icy Heights
programme.desc: This is a nature documentary, which leads us into the fascinating world of deep mountain lakes. We conquer ice palaces of unsuspected beauty. In the freezers, in which elves, fairies and mountain trolls once did their mischief, we move, using a special breathing technique and with special cameras in search of nocturnal hunters, whose eyes are equipped with residual light amplifying receptors.

programme.title: Montenegro - From the Black Mountains to the Beach
programme.desc: The Balkan land of Montenegro owes its name to the Black Mountains. But there is so much more: steep cliffs, deep gorges, picturesque lakes, orthodox monasteries, Venetian architecture, sandy beaches and even fjords like those of Norway. There are three climate zones alone in the Adriatic. The inhabitants still try to find their way between the challenges of a post-socialist system, the much-vaunted Balkan remoteness and the opportunities of a still almost completely undiscovered tourist destination in Europe.

programme.title: Wild Bavaria
programme.desc: The moon disappears behind the horizon and the stage is set for a new day in the Alps of Berchtesgaden.

programme.title: Wild Bavaria
programme.desc: Mighty and mysterious, King Watzmann sits above Germany's only alpine national park.

programme.title: The U.S. East Coast
programme.desc: Nowhere is the American way of life as relaxed as on Florida's beaches. The Keys, a chain of islands at the far southern end of the state, reveal a more laid-back side of the USA. But all of Florida amazes -- with secluded beaches, unspoiled nature, and the legacy of the early European settlers.

programme.title: The U.S. East Coast
programme.desc: The journey up the coast continues through Delaware to suburban New Jersey, and onwards into the heart of Manhattan. In Delaware, famous as a corporate tax haven, we visit a winery. In New York City we zip around with a bicycle courier and then head out to Long Island for oysters.

programme.title: The U.S. East Coast
programme.desc: From New York, the journey up the coast leads into the heart of New England. We visit Yale; spend some time in the 19th century mansions at Newport, RI; tour the coastal fishing and vacation towns of Massachusetts, and then meet a modern entrepreneur in Boston and see her rooftop gardens.

programme.title: Wild Baltic
programme.desc: The first episode of this two-part nature documentary presents the natural beauty of the shifting sand dunes of the Curonian Spit, the romantic beaches of the Latvian Baltic Sea and the island worlds of Estonia. Time and again, this deserted and almost untouched nature fascinates. In the winter, ringed seals give birth to their young on the pack ice. In the spring, Konik wild horse stallions fight fierce battles amongst themselves, while colourful European rollers fly through the dune forests. Lynxes wander through the coastal forests and in the orchid meadows turncoats and hoopoes find more than enough food. On the islands around Saaremaa in Estonia, grey seals hunt for fish. They share the archipelago with Europe’s largest tern, the Caspian tern.

programme.title: Wild Baltic
programme.desc: The wide, often untouched wilderness of the Baltic hinterland is home to many animals. More than 35 brown bears live in the primeval forests of Alutaguse. In the spring, the Soomaa National Park transforms into a huge lake. Europe's widest waterfall is located in Latvia. In the beginning of May, vimba bream follow the course of the River Venta. The hardly 5-centimetre-long fish have to overcome a 4-metre-long rock barrier in order to reach their spawning grounds.

programme.title: Hot Roads - The Worlds Most Dangerous Roads
programme.desc: The Halsema Highway, situated on the island Luzon, leads right through the Philippine jungle with its frequent fog and heavy rainfalls. Every trip on this so-called road is an adventure and highly dangerous. We accompany a bus driver and a taxi driver on their challenging trip across the mountains.

programme.title: Hot Roads - The Worlds Most Dangerous Roads
programme.desc: The Canadian ice roads exist only for a few months in the winter when the ice is thick enough. The only time of the year when goods can be transported up to Northern Manitoba. We accompany the truckers Vlad and Hugh as well as the aboriginal Canadian Scott with his pick-up on their long journey to a village called God’s Lake. A risky trip in icy temperatures, sometimes even below - 60 degrees Celcius. The men are in constant danger of getting stuck and need to forget everything they ever learnt about driving on a highway in order to arrive safely.

programme.title: Hot Roads - The Worlds Most Dangerous Roads
programme.desc: India's state of Rajasthan is known for its ancient palaces, vast landscapes - and wild transport routes. For thousands of years, dromedaries served as the most important means of transport. Today, India's roads are considered fast-paced, chaotic and unpredictable. On a journey through the desert state, we discover its rough roads.

programme.title: North America's National Parks
programme.desc: Yellowstone National Park is an American national park located in the western United States, largely in the northwest corner of Wyoming and extending into Montana, and Idaho. It was established by the U.S. Congress and signed into law by President Ulysses S. Grant on March 1, 1872. Yellowstone was the first national park in the U.S. and is also widely held to be the first national park in the world. The park is known for its wildlife and its many geothermal features, especially Old Faithful geyser, one of its most popular. While it represents many types of biomes, the subalpine forest is the most abundant. It is part of the South Central Rockies forests ecoregion.

programme.title: North America's National Parks
programme.desc: Great Smoky Mountains National Park is an American national park in the southeastern United States, with parts in Tennessee and North Carolina. The park straddles the ridgeline of the Great Smoky Mountains, part of the Blue Ridge Mountains, which are a division of the larger Appalachian Mountain chain. The park contains some of the highest mountains in eastern North America, including Clingmans Dome, Mount Guyot, and Mount Le Conte. The border between the two states runs northeast to southwest through the center of the park. The Appalachian Trail passes through the center of the park on its route from Georgia to Maine. With 12.5 million visitors in 2019, the Great Smoky Mountains National Park is the most visited national park in the United States.

programme.title: North America's National Parks
programme.desc: North America’s National Parks are world famous and their breathtaking landscapes fascinate millions of visitors. This spectacular series will show you what happens beyond the lookouts. Everglades National Park is an American national park that protects the southern twenty percent of the original Everglades in Florida. The park is the largest tropical wilderness in the United States, and the largest wilderness of any kind east of the Mississippi River. An average of one million people visit the park each year. Everglades is the third-largest national park in the contiguous United States after Death Valley and Yellowstone. UNESCO declared the Everglades & Dry Tortugas Biosphere Reserve in 1976, and listed the park as a World Heritage Site in 1979, while the Ramsar Convention included the park on its list of Wetlands of International Importance in 1987. Everglades is one of only three locations in the world to appear on all three lists.

programme.title: Project Antarctica
programme.desc: Why don't you do something sensible? - Tim, Michael and Dennis have heard this sentence more than once since their school days when they professed their dream jobs: Artist, photographer, filmmaker. And they went on to say that some dreams had to remain dreams, that work didn't have to be fun, but above all that it had to pay enough and be safe. A few years later, the three are working on their joint feature film. They put all their eggs in one basket and are determined to invest two years of working time to achieve their goal. Unpaid. It's not just any goal: the three want to travel to Antarctica. They want to find out whether it is possible to reach even the most distant destinations if you only want to. With ten boxes full of equipment, they set off on the 14,000 km journey to Antarctica. And thus on the journey of a lifetime...

programme.title: Darkwoods - Where Nature Survives
programme.desc: Half a century ago the German Duke Carl von Württemberg purchased a 55.000-hectare parcel of land in the Selkirk Mountains in British Columbia, Canada. He baptized his holdings after his native Black Forest, "Darkwoods", and managed the forests in the lonely region sustainably.

programme.title: mareTV: The Caribbean for explorers: St. Vincent and the Grenadines
programme.desc: Much more Caribbean than on the islands of St. Vincent and the Grenadines is hardly possible. Deserted beaches, uninhabited islands, lush vegetation, the 33 islands in total are dreamlike with extremely hospitable inhabitants. Miranda Phillips runs a laundry and water boat on Bequia. Every morning, the 32-year-old navigates from yacht to yacht with her small bright green service vehicle and is already expected by most skippers. Miranda promises radiantly fresh laundry, which she delivers again the same day. And so there is always something going on in her tiny laundrette in the harbour. It turns into a karaoke bar in the evening, because that is Miranda's great passion. Eban Olliver has many jobs at once. He is the lighthouse keeper of Kingstown. And that means a lot of responsibility in St. Vincent's biggest port city. Because Eban doesn't just change the light bulbs, he's a pilot dispatcher, harbour master and guard all in one person. First contact with ships is particularly important. Once he even saved the entire nation from an Ebola virus.

programme.title: mareTV: Martinique
programme.desc: The island of Martinique is a piece of France in the Caribbean, between Florida and South America. And of course, Savoir-vivre applies just as it does on the other side of the Atlantic, between the English Channel and the Mediterranean. Jacky Pascault is the first and only man to cultivate mushrooms in the Caribbean. Everywhere else, they grow on artificially fertilised soil, but Jacky's Champignons Tropicaux flourish on sugar cane fibres. Nicole Vilo tailors hats and dresses out of coconut palms. Of course, the catwalk for the models wearing her first collection is one of the countless dream beaches. The Martiniquais sail on boats they call Yole, which have no keel and are therefore difficult to navigate. The crew members hang over the water in breakneck fashion on long wooden poles. Just the job for Yole-boss Max' "problem kids": they not only learn complicated handling, but also team spirit.

programme.title: Elephants: Back to the Wild
programme.desc: We follow the rescue of a baby elephant. Once rescued, it will be transported by plane to the breeding station and raised with love and commitment. In order to satisfy the little pachyderm’s urge to move while in the breeding station, there is sometimes an adorable football match between the animals.

programme.title: Elephants: Back to the Wild
programme.desc: We accompany the first steps of a two-year-old elephant who is just starting his release program. We also observe the story of two young elephants in their first night in the wilderness on their own. Captivating film footage allows us to truly learn how elephants behave in the wild.

programme.title: Italy My Love
programme.desc: In ten coastal areas of Italy, we encounter people that have a very special relationship with their region. All of them love their country, their traditions and their work. We met with enthusiasts and hedonists that permitted us to take a glimpse into their everyday lives. Young Italians, who have rediscovered nature and its treasures. Others, that preserve the beauty, archaeologists that apply whole new methods, farmers that only cultivate that which the soil needs. Fishermen, who fish in the same way as it was done a century ago and tough, young men who play and dance the Tarantella. Dolphins, giant sea turtles and pink flamingos, which are researched, nursed back to health or simply observed. Cave explorers, sail makers and coffee specialists are also part of the big picture. Flying drone cameras provide birds-eye views and are an important element of the films. The results are spectacular images from completely different angles which provide us with landscape overviews and detailed insights, the likes of which have never been seen before.

programme.title: Wild Alpine Rivers - Life in the Extreme
programme.desc: What would happen to the mountains without water? They would turn into deserts, devoid of life and vegetation. But there are very few mountains without water on our planet. They take care of this themselves, creating their life’s element and taking water directly from the sky by entrapping the clouds around them. This water then collects on the flanks of the mountains, where it turns from rivulets into rivers, that flow out into the oceans. Mountains and water are symbiotic, a cycle that keeps life on earth going. Mountain streams slowly move along meadows before, only moments later, turning into the spray of waterfalls or small mystic lakes. What kind of life can be found in and around this mysterious cosmos? We will investigate the world of the rare Danube salmon and be there to see the Danube bleak spawn. We will follow giant wels catfish into their hideouts, see great crested grebes on their underwater hunting. We go diving under the ice of frozen mountain streams and lakes, discovering life where none was thought possible.

programme.title: Faroe Islands - A Secret Beauty
programme.desc: The Faroe Islands in the North Atlantic, located in the middle of the Gulf Stream between Scotland and Iceland, are an archipelago of eighteen green volcanic islands where a unique culture has developed over the last thousand years. As direct descendants of the Vikings, the Faroese feel committed to their traditions and hold on to customs, without missing out on the advantages of the modern and globalised world - from archaic hunter and shepherd culture to contemporary art. With the highest birth rate in Europe and the lowest social inequality in the world, the just fifty thousand Faroese are a very special people living on one of the last natural paradises in Europe.

programme.title: Myths of the Congo - Apes and Aliens
programme.desc: The Congo, mighty and deep like no other river - yet still a retreat and a habitat for several of our world's strangest animals. Our closest relatives live deep inside the dense jungles: three of the four giant ape species have made the Congo basin their home. Rich in extraordinary footage, the second episode of "Myths of the Congo" also presents exciting insights into one of the most mysterious and dangerous regions on earth.

programme.title: Myths of the Congo - Deep and Dangerous
programme.desc: The river that swallows all rivers - this is what the natives call it. In reality, the Congo, when considering its water masses, is the second largest and the deepest river in the world. At its source in the north of Zambia, it starts out as a mere trickle, but on its journey westwards it grows and grows, becoming ever mightier and with it, the animals, too: the shoebill stork hides in the dense papyrus. Metre-long pythons hunt for their prey in trees and huge hippos fight for power and respect in the water. To survive in the Congo, animals have to adapt to extreme conditions. Here, evolution has spawned unique creatures: fish with lungs, wings and those that go hunting on land. The Congo River feeds the second largest rainforest on earth. Here is the home of the forest elephant. Time and again, they are summoned to this one, magic place: the Dzanga Bay. Countless other forest dwellers join them. What makes this place so special?

programme.title: Wild Switzerland
programme.desc: Gentle, green meadows, rugged rock faces, mysterious lakes, dense forests, tall mountains, low-lying river deltas, quietly meandering mountain streams and smack dab in the middle, a unique fauna - THIS is Switzerland! We trace the elementary power of nature and present animals and plants in landscapes that have hardly ever been touched by mankind. Switzerland is an alpine country, but it is also Europe's surge tank. Rivers such as the Rhine and the Rhone have their sources here. Glaciers, crevasses, icy cold caves and the underwater dome of the Verzasca are the unusual settings we chose for this film. We meet with rare, selected animal species and present their behavioural patterns, such as the Swiss or Arven jay, the lynx and albino catfish. Cold, wind, snow and extreme locations demand adaptation that make us marvel.

programme.title: Europe's far North - Lofoten and the Arctic Ocean
programme.desc: Lofoten is the rugged archipelago in the Norwegian Arctic Ocean. Whoever arrives here is really at the end. Moskenes is the end of the line, and anyone who wants to go further needs a boat or a plane. The only way to get to the open sea is via the Maelstrom, which is quite dangerous. On the outermost headland, there are only a few ruins left. The last inhabitants are long gone, a supply was hardly possible. But fishermen are on the way, mainly to catch cod. And there is the coastal administration, which takes care of broken sea marks and lighthouses. A visit to one of the luxurious ships of the Hurtig Line is not to be missed. They shuttle off rough coasts on an eleven-day trip between the Russian border and southern Norway. A floating workplace for a wide variety of professions. The island of Andøya is not served by the Hurtiglinie. It lies too far out in the Atlantic. One of the most important observatories in Europe is located here. A young woman, Sandra Blindheim, is the boss. She is responsible for the large laser that delivers important information to scientists around the world. On clear winter nights, there is a wonderful panoramic view of the aurora borealis.

programme.title: North Macedonia: Between Traditional Dances and Mini Navy
programme.desc: Northern Macedonia emerged from being a once constituent republic of the former Yugoslavia. Anyone wishing to discover unknown worlds has every chance of finding them in this young Balkan country, full of imposing mountains, lakes of crystal-clear water, original villages and centuries-old customs. Nevertheless, Northern Macedonia, which borders Serbia in the north and Greece in the south, considered to be one of the poorest countries in Europe.

programme.title: Lonesome Dove
programme.desc: Texas Rangers and long-time ranching partners Gus McCrae and Woodrow Call meet their old friend Jake, and decide to strike out from their south Texas base and drive a cattle herd to Montana.

programme.title: Lonesome Dove
programme.desc: McCrae and Wood's cattle drive faces deadly situations. Sheriff July Johnson heads to Texas, and former prostitute Lorena is abandoned by Jake and kidnapped by the psychotic Blue Duck.

programme.title: Lonesome Dove
programme.desc: Gus and July save Lorena from Blue Duck, but at a deadly cost. Jake runs with a bad crowd and pays the price. July accepts that his wife has left him and stays on at Clara's with his newborn son.

programme.title: Lonesome Dove
programme.desc: The cattle drive reaches Nebraska, where Gus and Clara reunite. Drought and Indian attacks take their toll as the drive reaches Montana, and Gus is wounded. Call honors his best friend's request.

programme.title: Part 1
programme.desc: Acclaimed director Franco Zeffirelli and an all-star cast come together to deliver a powerful adaptation of the Gospels in 1977's Jesus Of Nazareth. From the Nativity to the Crucifixion and Resurrection, the life of Jesus (played by Robert Powell) is presented with stunning depth, gravity, and emotion.

programme.desc: Acclaimed director Franco Zeffirelli and an all-star cast come together to deliver a powerful adaptation of the Gospels in 1977's Jesus Of Nazareth. From the Nativity to the Crucifixion and Resurrection, the life of Jesus (played by Robert Powell) is presented with stunning depth, gravity, and emotion.

programme.title: Kentucky Rifle
programme.desc: (1955) Suspenseful western with Chill Wills, Lance Fuller and Cathy Downs. When a gun-filled wagon breaks down in enemy territory, will its occupants surrender their cargo or fight for their lives?

programme.title: War of the Wildcats
programme.desc: (1943) Classic western starring John Wayne. A tough cowboy and rich oil baron fight for power, land and love in 1900s Oklahoma. Who will triumph in this explosive battle of wills?

programme.title: Last Days Of Frank and Jesse James, The
programme.desc: A western about the notorious bank robbers, Frank and Jesse James

programme.title: Cruel Fixation
programme.desc: (2019) Tense thriller starring Kristina Klebe. A recently widowed woman grows suspicious of her insular son's new friend. Could his seemingly strange obsession with her turn sinister?

programme.title: A Murderer Upstairs
programme.desc: (2017) Taut thriller starring Josie Davis. After her stepdaughter witnesses a murder, Cindy tries to protect her. But as the truth unravels, is the greatest danger living under her own roof?

programme.title: Death By Friendship
programme.desc: (2020) Thriller with Natalie Brown. Recently divorced Hope thinks her struggling daughter is back on track when she bonds with Cassie, whose parents also split. But is Cassie a friend or a foe?

programme.title: The Black Widow Killer
programme.desc: (2018) Thriller starring Erin Karpluk. Twenty-five years ago, a car accident resulted in the near-death of a teenage girl. Now she's back to exact dark and lethal revenge on everyone involved...

programme.title: The Killer Downstairs
programme.desc: (2019) Disturbing thriller starring Cindy Busby. Alison thinks she's won the tenancy lottery when the seemingly perfect James moves into her basement. But some house rules are about to be broken...

programme.title: HELL IN NORMANDY
programme.desc: On the eve of D-Day, a company of paratroopers land on Omaha Beach with a dangerous mission.

programme.title: FIRST OF THE FEW, THE
programme.desc: An acclaimed aircraft designer works tirelessly to design an innovative new fighter plane

programme.title: Farewell to Arms
programme.desc: (1932) Romance starring Gary Cooper and Helen Hayes. A passionate romance blooms between a wounded American soldier and a brave nurse amidst the chaos and heartache of World War I.

programme.title: We Dive at Dawn
programme.desc: (1943) War drama starring John Mills. A WWII British submarine crew closes in on a deadly new German battleship. Just as they're ready to sink it, they run out of fuel.

programme.title: Tomorrow We Live
programme.desc: The French Resistance successfully sabotage a German armaments train near Saint - Nazaire.

programme.title: Air Rescue
programme.desc: Fly with the pilots and intensive care paramedics of The Westpac Lifesaver Rescue Helicopter Service who provide emergency medical treatment and assistance to those in life-threatening situations.

programme.title: Air Rescue
programme.desc: Fly with the pilots and intensive care paramedics of The Westpac Lifesaver Rescue Helicopter Service who provide emergency medical treatment and assistance to those in life-threatening situations.

programme.title: Ride in The Whirlwind
programme.desc: (1966) Western starring Jack Nicholson. Mistaken for outlaws, three cowboys find themselves on the run from a relentless posse hungry for justice.

programme.title: Four Fast Guns
programme.desc: (1960) Western with James Craig. A former gunslinger tries to restore order to a lawless town, but is foiled by the efforts of an evil saloon owner whose infirmity grants him immunity from violence.

programme.title: Johnson County War - Part 1
programme.desc: (2002) Contemporary western with Tom Berenger, Luke Perry and Burt Reynolds. Three brothers are pulled into a fiery conflict between old cowboys and new homesteaders. (1/2)

programme.title: Death Rides a Horse
programme.desc: (1967) Brutal western with Lee Van Cleef and John Phillip Law. Fifteen years after his family were massacred by bandits, a young boy is now a skilled gunslinger - and he's hell-bent on revenge...

programme.title: Air Rescue
programme.desc: Fly with the pilots and intensive care paramedics of The Westpac Lifesaver Rescue Helicopter Service who provide emergency medical treatment and assistance to those in life-threatening situations.

programme.title: Grandma Dearest
programme.desc: (2020) Thriller with Wendie Malick. Barbara longs to be a grandmother. In fact, she would kill for it. Can her new daughter-in-law expose her deadly intentions before it's too late?

programme.title: A Mother Betrayed
programme.desc: (2015) Tense drama with Lynn Collins. After a whirlwind wedding, a single mother finds herself committed to an institution when her husband plans to take everything she has - including her daughter.

programme.title: Killer Ending
programme.desc: (2018) Drama thriller starring Chelsea Hobbs. Crime fiction becomes a horrifying reality when a novelist's daughter is abducted in a copycat scenario taken straight from her latest book.

programme.title: Her Son's Secret
programme.desc: (2018) Thriller starring Olivia d'Abo. Years after he mysteriously disappeared, Sarah's son suddenly shows up at her door. However, as suspicions mount, is he really who he says he is?

programme.title: Out of Control
